sections.text:
In a small village located at the foothills of the green mountains, there was a young shepherd named “Salem,” whose job was to take the village’s sheep every morning to graze in the nearby hills.

Salem was very bored with this job. There was nothing to do but sit and watch the sheep eat grass for long hours.

He had no one to talk to except his small dog, so he hoped that anything would happen that would break this boring routine.

One day, a bad idea came into his head to have fun and create some excitement in his quiet village.

Salem stood on a high rock and covered his mouth with his hands, and began screaming at the top of his voice and in a tone full of artificial terror: “The wolf! The wolf! Help me! There is a wolf attacking the sheep!”

The peasants in the village heard Salem’s terrifying screams, so they immediately left their jobs and farms, grabbed their sticks and axes, and ran as fast as they could towards the hill to save the boy and the sheep.

The villagers arrived panting from fatigue. They looked around anxiously, but they found no trace of the wolf, and the sheep were grazing in complete peace.

When they looked at Salem, they found him rolling on the ground laughing so hard!
Salem said sarcastically: “I deceived you! There is no wolf. I was bored and wanted to have a little fun watching you run like that!”

The villagers became very angry at this ridiculous prank, scolded him harshly, and then went back to their work, complaining about his recklessness.

A few weeks passed, and boredom crept into Salem's heart again, so he decided to do it again!
He shouted again: "The wolf! Help! The wolf is devouring my sheep!"

Once again, the kind villagers believed him and ran to save him, only to find him laughing at them again.

The village elder said to him firmly this time: “Son, lying is not a game! If you keep this up, no one will believe you when you are in real danger.”

But Salem did not care about their advice, and thought that he was smarter than them all.

A few days later, on a cold autumn evening, as the sun was approaching sunset, Salem heard a strange movement among the dense bushes.

Suddenly, a huge and terrifying real wolf came out, bared its sharp fangs, and ferociously pounced on one of the sheep!
Salem was truly terrified this time, and began screaming with all his might, trembling and crying: “The wolf! The wolf! Please help me! The wolf is real this time!”

The villagers heard his screams in the village, but they looked at each other and said coldly: “Salem is lying again and wants to make fun of us. Let him scream until he gets tired, we will not go to him this time.”

Salem continued screaming and crying, but no one came to help him!
Salem remained alone and helpless, watching the wolf prey on his sheep one by one until he killed a large number of them and then fled into the forest.

Salem returned to the village in the evening, crying bitterly, while the remaining sheep walked behind him in fear, so the villagers asked him what happened.

Salem said crying: “The real wolf attacked my flock and killed my sheep! Why didn’t you come to help me when I screamed?!”

The village elder said to him calmly and wisely: “We came when you lied twice, but when you lie a lot, people completely lose their trust in you, and this is the punishment of a liar; no one believes him even if he tells the truth!”
Salem realized his grave mistake, and knew that his heavy jokes and constant lying were the cause of this great loss, and he decided never to lie in his life after that cruel day.
